rca_of_issue: Bug 'Investment showing in USD in Top Bar even when added in INR' — RCA: prior farm/[id].tsx summed sale.total and investment.amount directly without converting to farm.currency, so mixed/no conversion led to symbol-currency mismatch. FIX (already in place at farm/[id].tsx L52-53): totalRevenue = Σ convert(s.total, s.currency||'USD', farm.currency); totalInvest = Σ convert(x.amount, x.currency||farm.currency, farm.currency). MiniStat label now `"Revenue (${displayCurrency})"` and value `fmt(v, displayCurrency)`. Verified live: ₹500 INR investment renders as 'INVESTED (INR) ₹500' — NOT $500.
